subject.title: feat: open Control UI links in a macOS sidebar browser

question: Should OpenClaw add a native macOS dashboard sidebar browser for external Control UI links now, using the proposed two-PR bridge plus WKWebView split-pane design?
rationale: This is a new native UI/product surface with security and persistence choices, and the live issue has the protected maintainer label, so automation should not choose the direction alone.

options.title: Approve the two-PR native design
options.body: Proceed with a narrow bridge PR followed by a macOS WKWebView sidebar PR, with browser-host parity tests and macOS visual proof.

options.title: Defer pending browser-boundary design
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers define the security, persistence, and external-page behavior for native embedded browsing.

options.title: Keep default-browser behavior
options.body: Reject the native sidebar surface and continue opening external links through the system browser for clearer security boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve the two-PR native design
recommendation.body: Proceed with a narrow bridge PR followed by a macOS WKWebView sidebar PR, with browser-host parity tests and macOS visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the request and owns the recent merged history for the implicated macOS dashboard and Control UI link paths.
